title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 238 ]

blocks.text: Abundant energy is essential to modern civilization. Energy beyond that provided by human or animal muscles is needed for operating our factories, for heating and cooking our homes, for powering most forms of transportation, and for hundreds of other purposes, Presently coal and oil supply the majority of our energy needs. But coal, when burned, tends to pollute the air, and oil is becoming scarcer. Other sources, therefore, must be developed.

readingSentences.english: Abundant energy is essential to modern civilization.

Energy beyond that provided by human or animal muscles is needed for operating our factories, for heating and cooking our homes, for powering most forms of transportation, and for hundreds of other purposes, Presently coal and oil supply the majority of our energy needs.
readingSentences.korean: 우리의 공장을 가동하고, 가정에 난방을 하고 요리를 하며, 대부분의 운송 수단에 동력을 공급하고, 수백 가지 다른 목적을 위해 인간이나 동물의 근육이 제공하는 것 이상의 에너지가 필요하다. 현재는 석탄과 석유가 우리 에너지 수요의 대부분을 공급하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: But coal, when burned, tends to pollute the air, and oil is becoming scarcer.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 석탄은 연소될 때 공기를 오염시키는 경향이 있고, 석유는 점점 더 희소해지고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Other sources, therefore, must be developed.
readingSentences.korean: 그러므로 다른 에너지원이 반드시 개발되어야 한다.
